title: NextNav Demonstrates Exceptional First-Ever Wireless Indoor Timing Solution for Critical Infrastructure
summary: NextNav announced real-world field validation of timing accuracy of approximately 20 nanoseconds (billionths of a second) using Positioning Reference Signals (PRS) transmitted by its operational 5G PNT Network in Santa Clara County, CA. The field validation was conducted over-the-air in both outdoor and indoor environments, including GPS-denied locations. The timing results demonstrate how NextNav’s planned 5G-powered 3D PNT solution in the lower 900 MHz band can deliver timing information to serve critical infrastructure needs.
